name: g1
_note: G1 23-DOF run through the SAME generic harness as H1/Valkyrie, to test whether the centering+stiffening method makes its stand robust. Pose = G1's documented deeper squat (hip -0.30/knee 0.52/ankle -0.23) + arms-down (g1_stand_arms_deploy). deploy_ke/ank_bias are swept empirically.
_armsdown_note: HOME pose: arms a single STRAIGHT line hanging down beside the body. elbow=0.5 makes the forearm COLLINEAR with the upper arm -- NOT 0 (that bends the forearm ~90 deg straight forward, VERIFIED by render: elbow origin offsets put the forearm along +X while the upper arm is along -Z). The upper arm is already rotated down ~90 deg by shoulder_pitch=1.5708, so the forearm needs only ~+0.5 more to line up (rendered sweep: 0=90deg-fwd, 0.45-0.6=straight/vertical, >=0.8 swings forward again, 1.5708 over-rotates forward-up). shoulder_roll=0 (parallel, no splay), shoulder_yaw=wrist=0 (no twist). Arms swing freely from here for balance; body returns to 0-rad upright via the integrals.
_armsdown_trim: ank_bias -0.10. Arms-down shifts the CoM so the bare stand is marginal; the ARMS (arm_balance kp=6, fast P) + the return-to-home integrals (arm ki + hip auto_trim ki) hold it and drive the body back to 0 rad upright. Verified: holds all 8 thrown cubes and returns pitch & roll to 0.000, no fall, robust COLD (the integral absorbs the cold-load offset -- no warm reload needed). Ankle active feedback DESTABILISES this stiff stand, so the return uses ARMS + HIP only, never the ankle.
_result: Through this generic harness G1 STANDS robustly with ank_bias -0.06 (KE 400): 0 falls over 400s+ sim. At bias 0 it tips forward at 1.46s -- the SAME marginal forward-CoM failure as H1/Valkyrie at bias 0, fixed by the SAME backward-ankle centering. Confirms G1's committed stand was marginal only because its pose was not centred. Basin ~[-0.05,-0.07]: bias 0/-0.03 tip forward, -0.09 tips back.

lean._note: G1's stand is marginal (forward-CoM), so the reactive ankle lean earns its keep -- it holds all thrown cubes where the passive stand drops them. H1/Valkyrie are stiff enough to hold passively and the lean HURTS them, so they leave it off.

arm_balance._note: One-leg: arm PITCH balance holds fore/aft AND arm ROLL balance (kept ON) holds the pelvis level -- WITHOUT it the body slowly rolls over and falls ~6s even with no leg lift. The one_leg lateral shift is a TRANSLATE (pelvis stays level), so it does NOT fight the roll-to-0; the arms also ramp OUT as outriggers on top.

auto_trim._note: HIP-ONLY return-to-home (NOT ankle -- ankle feedback destabilises this stiff stand). Integral of absolute pitch leans the torso back via the hips to bring the body all the way to 0 rad (upright HOME) after a tilt, where a proportional-only controller would settle at an offset.

one_leg._note: SHIPPED config = stable WEIGHT-SHIFT onto the support leg. A slow hip translate + the torque-bounded ankle CoP (ankle_torque) drive the CoM over the support foot and HOLD it there (rock-stable 50s+, verified). lift_knee/lift_hip=0 -> the swing foot stays grazing (NOT fully cleared): true foot-off single support falls ~8-9s on this robot because the frontal-plane instability exceeds bounded ankle-CoP + limb momentum (swept exhaustively -- needs WBC, see project_g1_oneleg_attempt). The arm pitch-balance + hip trim hold fore/aft; ankle CoP holds lateral.
